findings.claim: Q3 2026 營收 $24.4B 年增 39%，量增 53%、實現價格下降約 15%；Mounjaro $10.7B(+65%，美國 $5.0B +41%，美國以外 $5.7B +93%)、Zepbound $5.35B(約+49%)
findings.excerpt: In Q3 2026, worldwide revenue was $24.4 billion, an increase of 39% compared with Q3 2025, driven by a 53% increase in volume, partially offset by a 15% decrease in realized prices. Key Products1 revenue grew to $17.1 billion in Q3 2026, led by Mounjaro and Zepbound.

findings.claim: Q3 後 2026 全年營收指引上調至 $91–92B(前次 $85–87B)
findings.source: Zacks: LLY stock jumps as Q3 earnings beat estimates, 2026 sales view raised

findings.claim: 價格壓力：美國定價受 Zepbound/Mounjaro 影響，Mounjaro 納入中國 NRDL 壓低海外價格，Zepbound 現金自付價降低
肥胖藥市場 2030 預測差異大(JPM GLP-1 類 >$100B、約 2,500 萬美國使用者；GS 基準約 $100B，近期更保守因價格侵蝕)
